issues.message: 实物深度、颜色、声音、感情强度、理解、睡眠和呼吸混在两个大义项中，例句未分别覆盖。声音义也不宜列为较少用义。应分开补足例句，并统一移动后各例的 senseId。
too deep for the little dog 没有表达小狗“游不过去”；原译增加了未经句子说明的能力判断。
deep/deeply 的常见分工基本正确，但需要说明 sleep deeply、breathe deeply 等交叉用法，并补充常用的 deep down。
名词 the deep 应注明书面或文学色彩；the ocean's deep 不适合作常用搭配。“很少有动物能生活在深海”也不宜作为一般事实教学。
depth 本来就是与 deep 对应的同族名词，the depths 也能表示海洋深处，原辨析容易造成误解。积雪可以达到膝盖，原例却让抽象的 depth 达到膝盖，表达不自然。
古英语在前、原始日耳曼语在后的阶段数组会生成反向历史箭头；重构阶段也没有可用的词义说明。应把可证实的重构关系保留在 summary，仅保留有明确释义的古英语阶段。
“把石头挖进泥土”搭配不成立；池边、池底和上岸的行动衔接也不清楚。
Oxford 页面没有出现在实际取得的材料中，应撤去相应证据关联；词典明确支持的内容改引已取得的英语词条，专业语言知识补充使用空 sourceIds，并补列古英语 deop 的实际来源。

review.coverageAssessment: 已核对材料明示的实物深度、颜色、副词和名词用法，并补齐常见的声音、感情与影响、理解与思考、专注、睡眠和呼吸用法。各核心义均有至少两例，具体深度的度量结构也已补入；时间延伸作为补充义。原声音补充义已移入主干，新 lessCommonSenses 示例与其所属 senseId 一致。未声称核验未取得的 Oxford 或 Cambridge 正文；体育、技术等专门义未展开。

senseInventory.sense: 形容词：实际深度大，包括向下或向内部延伸
senseInventory.assessment: 保留独立核心义，移出颜色和声音，补足两个实际深度例句。

senseInventory.sense: 形容词：数值加单位后表示有多深
senseInventory.assessment: 补入 two metres deep 的例句与结构说明。
从原混合义项独立，补足两例，并限定与 dark、light、pale 的关系。
提升为常见义，保留原鼓声例句并补充嗓音例句；不与音量大小混淆。

senseInventory.sense: 形容词：感情、感受或影响强烈
senseInventory.assessment: 收窄为强度义，以悲伤和印象两例覆盖，并更换原先跨义的反向表达。

senseInventory.sense: 形容词：思想或问题深刻，理解透彻
senseInventory.assessment: 补充理解和问题两例，区分 profound 与 thorough 的适用范围。

senseInventory.sense: 形容词：专注或沉浸于某种思想、活动
senseInventory.assessment: 补入 be deep in thought/conversation 两个常见结构例句。
从抽象大义项独立，补足两例，并与 light sleep 对照。
独立说明 deep breath，补足两例，并与动词结构 breathe deeply 区分。

senseInventory.sense: 副词：达到较深位置或深入内部
senseInventory.assessment: 原有根系和船只例句自然，予以保留。

senseInventory.sense: 副词短语：deep down，内心深处
senseInventory.assessment: 补入两例及与 on the surface 的语境对照。
保留两例，注明通常单数、常带 the 及书面色彩，避免泛化成任意地方的深处。

senseInventory.sense: 副词：时间延续到很晚的阶段
senseInventory.assessment: 以 deep into the night 作为补充义介绍，示例归属正确。

patches.valueJson: {"id":"deep-adj-color","title":"形容词：颜色深浓的","meaning":"形容颜色深而浓，如深蓝、深红。","usageNote":"deep 常放在颜色词前。它描述颜色本身，不表示房间或环境光线暗。","examples":[{"id":"deep-365-color-1","senseId":"deep-adj-color","en":"She chose a deep blue bag for school.","zh":"她选了一个深蓝色的书包。","note":"deep blue 是深浓的蓝色。"},{"id":"deep-365-color-2","senseId":"deep-adj-color","en":"He painted the kitchen wall a deep red.","zh":"他把厨房的墙刷成了深红色。","note":"a deep red 指一种深浓的红色。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"deep + 颜色词","zh":"深……色","note":"如 deep blue、deep red，描述色调深浓。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"collocations":[{"en":"deep blue / red","zh":"深蓝色／深红色","note":"deep 修饰后面的颜色词。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"dark","zh":"深色的","note":"描述颜色时常与 deep 接近；dark 侧重颜色较暗，deep 侧重色调深浓。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"light","zh":"浅色的","note":"如 light blue 与 deep blue，在颜色深浅上形成对照。"},{"en":"pale","zh":"淡色的","note":"强调颜色淡，常可与浓重的 deep 色调对照。"}],"similarNote":"dark 与 deep 在颜色表达中有重叠，搭配和侧重点并不完全相同。","contrastingNote":"light、pale 的对照限于颜色，不用于替换实际水深的反义词 shallow。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary_fr_deep"]}

patches.valueJson: {"id":"deep-adj-quiet","title":"形容词：声音低沉的","meaning":"形容声音音调低，听起来低沉、厚实。","usageNote":"常修饰 voice、sound、rumble；这里说的是音调，不是音量大小。","examples":[{"id":"deep-365-e1","senseId":"deep-adj-quiet","en":"A deep drumbeat came from the next room.","zh":"隔壁房间传来低沉的鼓声。","note":"deep 描述声音低沉、厚实。"},{"id":"deep-365-voice-2","senseId":"deep-adj-quiet","en":"I recognized my brother by his deep voice on the phone.","zh":"在电话里，我凭哥哥低沉的嗓音认出了他。","note":"a deep voice 指音调低的嗓音，不表示说话声音小。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"have a deep voice","zh":"嗓音低沉","note":"deep 是形容词，修饰 voice。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a deep voice / rumble","zh":"低沉的嗓音／隆隆声","note":"描述声音的低音调。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"low-pitched","zh":"低音调的","note":"明确表示音调低，在声音语境中与 deep 接近。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"high-pitched","zh":"高音调的；尖细的","note":"与 deep 在音调高低上形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"low-pitched 与 deep 在音调语境中相近；deep 还常带低沉厚实的听感。","contrastingNote":"high-pitched 对照音调；loud、quiet 对照音量，不能混为一谈。"},"sourceIds":[]}

patches.valueJson: {"id":"deep-adj-thinking","title":"形容词：理解透彻的、思想深刻的","meaning":"形容理解深入透彻，或思想、问题深刻，需要认真思考。","usageNote":"常见于 a deep understanding、a deep question、deep thoughts；问题有时也可译为“深奥的”。","examples":[{"id":"deep-365-thinking-1","senseId":"deep-adj-thinking","en":"The nurse has a deep understanding of older patients' needs.","zh":"这位护士对老年患者的需求有深入的理解。","note":"deep understanding 强调理解透彻，不只知道表面情况。"},{"id":"deep-365-thinking-2","senseId":"deep-adj-thinking","en":"My daughter asked a deep question about why people tell lies.","zh":"女儿问了一个关于人为什么说谎的深刻问题。","note":"deep question 指需要认真思考的问题，不表示问题很长。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"have a deep understanding of ...","zh":"对……有深入的理解","note":"of 后接理解的对象。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a deep question / deep thoughts","zh":"深刻的问题／深刻的想法","note":"表示思想内容有深度。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"profound","zh":"深刻的","note":"用于思想、问题、见解等，比 deep 更正式。"},{"en":"thorough","zh":"透彻的；全面的","note":"如 a thorough understanding，与 deep understanding 接近，侧重充分、全面。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"superficial","zh":"表面的；肤浅的","note":"如 a superficial understanding，与理解深入透彻形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"profound 常评价思想有深度；thorough 适合强调理解全面，不能随意替换 deep question。","contrastingNote":"superficial 用于理解或思考的深浅对照；问题简单并不一定缺乏深度。"},"sourceIds":[]}

patches.valueJson: {"id":"deep-adj-absorbed","title":"形容词：专注的、沉浸的","meaning":"指非常投入某种思想或活动，注意力集中在其中。","usageNote":"常用 be deep in thought 或 be deep in conversation；这里不是实际空间很深。","examples":[{"id":"deep-365-absorbed-1","senseId":"deep-adj-absorbed","en":"Mum was deep in thought and didn't hear the doorbell.","zh":"妈妈陷入沉思，没有听见门铃。","note":"be deep in thought 表示专注思考。"},{"id":"deep-365-absorbed-2","senseId":"deep-adj-absorbed","en":"The two neighbours were deep in conversation when I arrived.","zh":"我到时，两位邻居正聊得很投入。","note":"be deep in conversation 表示交谈得很投入。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"be deep in thought / conversation","zh":"陷入沉思／投入交谈","note":"deep 作表语，后面接 in 短语。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"deep in thought","zh":"陷入沉思","note":"常用来描述认真思考、没有留意周围的状态。","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"absorbed in","zh":"专注于","note":"可表示注意力投入某种思想或活动，通常后接名词或动名词。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"distracted","zh":"分心的","note":"从注意力是否集中这一角度，与专注状态形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"absorbed in 的使用范围较广；deep in thought、deep in conversation 是应整体记住的常见搭配。","contrastingNote":"这里比较注意力是否集中，不涉及实际深浅。"},"sourceIds":[]}

patches.valueJson: {"id":"deep-adj-sleep","title":"形容词：睡眠很沉的","meaning":"形容睡眠很沉，不容易被吵醒。","usageNote":"deep 修饰 sleep；说某人正熟睡可用 be in a deep sleep，不能只用 be deep 表示睡着。","examples":[{"id":"deep-365-sleep-1","senseId":"deep-adj-sleep","en":"Dad was in a deep sleep after the long trip.","zh":"长途旅行后，爸爸睡得很沉。","note":"in a deep sleep 表示处于熟睡状态。"},{"id":"deep-365-sleep-2","senseId":"deep-adj-sleep","en":"Don't wake the baby; she's in a deep sleep.","zh":"别叫醒宝宝，她正睡得很沉。","note":"deep 是形容词，修饰名词 sleep。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"be in a deep sleep","zh":"睡得很沉","note":"描述正在熟睡的状态。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"deep sleep","zh":"深睡；沉睡","note":"强调睡眠很沉。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"sound sleep","zh":"酣睡；熟睡","note":"也表示睡得很熟，常强调睡得安稳。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"light sleep","zh":"浅睡","note":"指容易被吵醒的睡眠，与 deep sleep 对照。"}],"similarNote":"sound sleep 与 deep sleep 意思接近；改用动词时可说 sleep deeply 或 sleep soundly。","contrastingNote":"light 在这里表示睡眠浅，与颜色浅的用法不同。"},"sourceIds":[]}

patches.valueJson: {"id":"deep-adj-breath","title":"形容词：呼吸深的","meaning":"形容呼吸幅度大，吸气时吸入较多空气。","usageNote":"take a deep breath 表示深吸一口气；deep 修饰名词 breath。breathe deeply 是“动词 + 副词”结构。","examples":[{"id":"deep-365-breath-1","senseId":"deep-adj-breath","en":"She took a deep breath before answering the difficult question.","zh":"回答那个难题前，她深吸了一口气。","note":"a deep breath 是一次深呼吸。"},{"id":"deep-365-breath-2","senseId":"deep-adj-breath","en":"He took a few deep breaths before his speech.","zh":"发言前，他深呼吸了几次。","note":"breath 是可数名词，a few 后用复数 breaths。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"take a deep breath","zh":"深吸一口气","note":"take 后接名词 breath，deep 是形容词。","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"collocations":[{"en":"deep breaths","zh":"深呼吸","note":"多次深呼吸用 breaths。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"breathe deeply","zh":"深呼吸","note":"用动词 breathe 和副词 deeply 表达，不可原样放进 take a deep breath 的位置。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"a shallow breath","zh":"一次浅呼吸","note":"与 a deep breath 在呼吸深浅上形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"take a deep breath 与 breathe deeply 描述相近动作，但前者是动词加名词短语，后者是动词加副词。","contrastingNote":"shallow 对照呼吸幅度；quick 对照速度，不能把“快”直接当作“深”的反义。"},"sourceIds":[]}

patches.valueJson: {"id":"deep-adv-time","title":"副词：延续到很晚的时间","meaning":"在 deep into the night 等表达中，表示已经进入夜里很晚的阶段。","note":"这是空间深度向时间的延伸；可把 deep into the night 整体记作“直到深夜”。","example":{"id":"deep-365-time-1","senseId":"deep-adv-time","en":"We talked deep into the night after the party.","zh":"聚会结束后，我们一直聊到深夜。","note":"deep into the night 强调谈话持续到夜里很晚。"},"sourceIds":[]}
